methodologyNotes: Covers standalone document scanners sold at a published US MSRP: sheetfed/ADF desktop scanners, flatbed scanners, portable bus-powered sheetfed scanners, and dedicated photo-and-document scanners. Excludes all-in-one printer/scanner MFP devices, smartphone scanning apps, book/overhead scanners, and production-line scanners priced above typical small-office tiers. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD. formFactor is an enum (sheetfed-adf, flatbed, flatbed-adf, portable-sheetfed). simplexSpeedPpm is manufacturer-rated one-sided throughput in pages per minute at 300 dpi color, Letter/A4. duplexSpeedIpm is manufacturer-rated double-sided throughput in images per minute (one two-sided sheet = 2 images) at 300 dpi color; null if the unit is simplex-only. opticalResolutionDpi is the native optical sensor resolution in dots per inch, NOT interpolated. adfCapacitySheets is the rated auto-document-feeder tray capacity in sheets of 20 lb / 80 gsm paper; null if flatbed-only. duplexScan is true for single-pass double-sided scanning. connectivity is an enum (usb, usb-wifi, usb-wifi-ethernet) describing the highest tier of interfaces included. touchscreen is true if the unit has an onboard control touchscreen. dailyDutyCycleSheets is the manufacturer's recommended maximum sheets per day; null if not disclosed. maxMediaWidthMm is the maximum scannable media width in millimeters. weightKg is the device weight in kilograms.
